
# Africa Admin-1 Conflict Events and Population Exposure Analysis (2000–2026) Using ACLED Data

# Packages and Data Preparation
```{r}
# Packages
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(terra)

# Setup Paths
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
path <- "~Ebola Outbreak DRC/Conflict Data and Script"
output_path <- "~Ebola Outbreak DRC/Conflict Data and Script"
dir.create(output_path, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Africa Boundaries
africa <- st_read(file.path(path, "Africa_admin1.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  select(shapeGroup, shapeName)

# Load and clean ACLED data
conflict_sf <- read_excel(file.path(path, "Africa_conflict_ACLED.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(WEEK), 
    year = year(date)
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("CENTROID_LONGITUDE", "CENTROID_LATITUDE"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(africa)) %>%
  st_join(africa, left = FALSE)

# Time Periods
periods <- list(
  "2000-2010" = 2000:2010,
  "2011-2021" = 2011:2021,
  "2022-2026" = 2022:2026,
  "2000-2026" = 2000:2026
)
```

# Conflict Events Analysis
```{r}
# Process each period for Conflict Events
for (p_name in names(periods)) {
  years_vector <- periods[[p_name]]
  
  # Summarize Mean Annual Events
  map_data <- conflict_sf %>%
    filter(year %in% years_vector) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(shapeGroup, shapeName) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_annual_events = sum(coalesce(EVENTS, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / length(years_vector),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    right_join(africa, by = c("shapeGroup", "shapeName")) %>%
    st_as_sf() %>%
    mutate(mean_annual_events = replace_na(mean_annual_events, 0))
  
  # Plot Map
  p <- ggplot(map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_annual_events), color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.05) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      name = "Mean annual\nconflict events",
      na.value = "grey95",
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5)
    ) +
    labs(title = paste("Conflict Events:", p_name)) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  print(p)
  
  # Export Raster
  template <- rast(ext(map_data), resolution = 0.05, crs = st_crs(map_data)$wkt)
  event_raster <- rasterize(
    vect(map_data), 
    template, 
    field = "mean_annual_events", 
    fun = "mean"
  )
  
  writeRaster(
    event_raster,
    file.path(output_path, paste0("Conflict_", p_name, ".tif")),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
}
```

# Population Exposure Analysis
```{r}
# Process each period for Population Exposure
for (p_name in names(periods)) {
  years_vector <- periods[[p_name]]
  
  # Summarize Mean Annual Population Exposure
  map_data <- conflict_sf %>%
    filter(year %in% years_vector) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(shapeGroup, shapeName) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_annual_exposure = sum(coalesce(POPULATION_EXPOSURE, 0), na.rm = TRUE) / length(years_vector),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    right_join(africa, by = c("shapeGroup", "shapeName")) %>%
    st_as_sf() %>%
    mutate(mean_annual_exposure = replace_na(mean_annual_exposure, 0))
  
  # Plot Map
  p <- ggplot(map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_annual_exposure), color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.05) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      name = "Mean annual\npopulation exposure",
      na.value = "grey95",
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5)
    ) +
    labs(title = paste("Population Exposure:", p_name)) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  print(p)
  
  # Export Raster
  template <- rast(ext(map_data), resolution = 0.05, crs = st_crs(map_data)$wkt)
  exposure_raster <- rasterize(
    vect(map_data), 
    template, 
    field = "mean_annual_exposure", 
    fun = "mean"
  )
  
  writeRaster(
    exposure_raster,
    file.path(output_path, paste0("ConflictExposure_", p_name, ".tif")),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
}
```
